limitations: Requires valid SPIR-V accepted by naga 30.0.1; GLSL source must be compiled first.
The MVP targets compute shaders and WebGPU-compatible storage/uniform resources.
Unsupported or backend-specific SPIR-V capabilities must fail explicitly; no text-level WGSL fallback is allowed.
Resource decorations and std140 layout must be checked against wgsl-host-contract.json after conversion.
MaterialX closures remain limited to the host-generator MVP models and supported naga SPIR-V features.
